reference_definition: original strong reference plus frozen enriched habitat/environment predictors
candidate_definition: enriched reference plus the same frozen source-conditioned topology coordinate
scoring_rule: compare topology heldout loss increment under original versus enriched reference without changing partitions or topology operator
uncertainty_rule: predeclared block-aware uncertainty with no post-outcome resampling changes
success_rule: environmental-proxy explanation is supported only if enriched reference improves heldout prediction and the frozen topology increment collapses according to the predeclared proxy rule
primary_estimand: change in incremental topology information after the frozen enriched non-topological environment reference

lane_specific.proxy_decision_rule: topology increment moves to the predeclared practically-null interval while enriched reference improves heldout loss
